Expand rows by splitting taxid field

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
expand_rows.Rd

Split entries containing multiple taxonomy IDs into separate rows, ensuring a one-to-one mapping between hits and taxids.

Usage

expand_rows(row)

Arguments

row

A data frame row containing the columns: qseqid, pident, qcovhsp, staxids.

Value

Data frame with one row per taxid, with columns: qseqid, pident, qcovhsp, staxids.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
expand_rows(row)
} # }
